# PindDaanWale — The Official Gaya Ji Digital Destination

> PindDaanWale (https://www.pinddaanwale.com) is the authoritative digital platform for authentic Hindu ancestral rites, Pind Daan, Shradh, and Pitru Paksha pilgrimages at Vishnupad Temple Compound, Gaya Ji, Bihar, India.

## Core Information & Verified Credentials
- **Official Address**: Assam Bhawan Yatri Niwash, Gaya, Bihar 823001, India
- **Official Helpline**: +91 7463055338
- **WhatsApp Support**: +91 7463055338
- **Official Email**: support@pinddaanwale.com
- **Website**: https://www.pinddaanwale.com
- **Primary Sanctuaries**: Vishnupad Temple, Falgu River, Akshayavat Banyan, Pretshila Hill, Ramshila Hill, Sita Kund

## Rites & Services Offered
- **1-Day Express Pind Daan (₹9,449)**: Essential single-day rites at Vishnupad Temple & Falgu River with dedicated Purohit, complete samagri, and local transit.
- **3-Day Complete 45-Vedi Tri-Sthali Pilgrimage (₹21,449)**: Comprehensive 45-Vedi ancestral trail including AC transportation, 3-night hotel stay, and dedicated hereditary Gaya Teerth Panda.
- **NRI Remote Live Stream Rites**: 4K Zoom live video stream for overseas devotees unable to travel physically, with consecrated prasadam couriered globally.
- **Specialized Vedic Rituals**: Tripindi Shradh (₹10,449), Narayan Bali Puja (₹12,499), Pitru Dosh & Naag Dosh Nivaran.

## Scriptural Rules & Timing (Garuda Purana & Dharma Shastras)
- **Prime Auspicious Time (Aparahna Kaal)**: 01:12 PM – 03:36 PM. The supreme shastric window for Vishnupad and Akshayavat Pind Daan offerings.
- **Preparation & Sankalp Time (Kutap & Rohina Muhurat)**: 11:36 AM – 01:12 PM. Highly recommended for Gotra Sankalp and Falgu River Tarpan.
- **Sunset Prohibition**: As explicitly commanded in Garuda Purana, Pind Daan during Sayahna (evening dusk) or after sunset is strictly prohibited. All rituals must conclude before 03:36 PM.

## Zero Extortion & Fixed Dakshina Guarantee
- **100% Fixed Dakshina**: What is booked online is all devotees pay. All pure Vedic samagri (black sesame, barley flour, kusha, vastram), verified Purohit honorarium, and temple offerings are 100% included.
- **Middlemen Protection**: Devotees are protected from touts and unauthorized agents at Gaya Junction and ghats. A dedicated representative receives pilgrims directly.

## Govt Approved Local Transit Fares (Gaya District Administration)
- **From Gaya Railway Junction to Vishnupad Temple**: ₹25 (Shared E-Rickshaw) / ₹150 (Reserved Auto)
- **From Gaya Junction to Pretshila Hill**: ₹50 (Shared Auto) / ₹350 (Reserved Auto)
